rules.title: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting (S.2983)
rules.requirement: Proposed state legislation would prohibit algorithmic rent setting in Massachusetts rental housing. The page does not give the bill's operative provisions.
rules.citation: Senate Bill S.2983, 194th General Court (new draft of S.994 and S.1016)
rules.quoted_span: Senate, March 12, 2026 -- The committee on Housing, to whom was referred the petitions (accompanied by bill, Senate, No. 994) of Cindy F. Friedman and Julian Cyr for legislation to prohibit algorithmic rent setting; and (accompanied by bill, Senate, No. 1016) of Michael O. Moore, Patricia D. Jehlen and James B. Eldridge for legislation to establish the Preventing Algorithmic Rent Fixing in the Rental Housing Market Act., report the accompanying bill (Senate, No. 2983).
rules.extraction_note: The source is a bill history page only; the bill text is not included. The bill was reported favorably by the Joint Committee on Housing on 3/12/2026 and referred to Senate Ways and Means, so it is not law as of 2026-10-01. The page does not state the covered software, prohibited conduct, penalties or effective date.
